claim_text_zh: 祝允明生于明天顺五年（1461年），苏州府长洲县人。
claim_text_en: Zhu Yunming was born in 1461 in Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture (modern Suzhou, Jiangsu).
place: 苏州府长洲县（今江苏苏州）

claim_text_en: His courtesy name was Xizhe (希哲) and art name was Zhishan (枝山).

claim_text_zh: 祝允明因手有六指（多指畸形），自号'枝指生'（'枝指'即多余手指）。
claim_text_en: Born with a supernumerary thumb (polydactyly), he gave himself the sobriquet 'Zhizhi Scholar' (枝指生).
review_note: 《明人传记辞典》载左手多一指；钱谦益《列朝诗集小传》记为右手。

claim_text_zh: 祝允明四岁能作大字书法，八岁能诗。
claim_text_en: He was said to have been able to write calligraphy with large characters at age four and compose poetry by age eight.
review_note: 台北故宫展览介绍及明人传记辞典均载此事。

claim_text_zh: 祝允明十六岁为生员（入府学）。
claim_text_en: He became a certified student (shengyuan) at age 16.

claim_text_zh: 祝允明于弘治五年（1492年）中应天府乡试举人。
claim_text_en: He passed the provincial examination (xiangshi) in 1492.

claim_text_zh: 祝允明终身未中进士（会试不第）。
claim_text_en: He never passed the metropolitan examination (huishi) to become a jinshi.

claim_text_zh: 祝允明于正德九年（1514年）出任广东兴宁知县，任职约五年。
claim_text_en: He was appointed county magistrate of Xingning, Guangdong in 1514, serving about five years.

claim_text_zh: 祝允明在兴宁知县任上主修《正德兴宁县志》。
claim_text_en: During his term in Xingning, he served as principal editor of the Gazetteer of Xingning County (Zhengde reign).

claim_text_zh: 祝允明于正德十六年（1521年）升任应天府通判，旋即称病辞官。
claim_text_en: In 1521 he was promoted to Controller-General of Yingtian Prefecture (Nanjing), but resigned in less than a year on a plea of illness.

claim_text_zh: 祝允明辞官后专心著述至终老。
claim_text_en: After resigning, he dedicated the rest of his life to writing.

claim_text_zh: 祝允明批评朱熹理学，推崇王阳明心学。他写有大量批评传统价值观的文章。
claim_text_en: He criticized orthodox Neo-Confucianism of Zhu Xi and admired the philosophy of mind advocated by Wang Yangming. He wrote many essays criticizing traditional values.

claim_text_zh: 祝允明的历史人物评断作品影响了李贽的《藏书》。
claim_text_en: His works of judgements on historical personalities influenced Li Zhi's Cang Shu.
review_note: 学术观点。剑桥中国文学史及剑桥中国史均提及此影响。

claim_text_en: In his later life, he described himself as a 'wild man' (kuangren).

claim_text_zh: 祝允明以狂草（kuangcao）名世，亦精于小楷（xiaokai）。其友人认为狂野的草书风格反映了其冲动不羁的个性。
claim_text_en: He excelled at small standard script (xiaokai) and was famous for wild cursive (kuangcao). Friends attributed his affinity for highly expressive calligraphy to his impetuous personality.

claim_text_zh: 祝允明与唐寅、文徵明、徐祯卿并称“吴中四才子”（后世文学并称），其书法在四才子中最受称道。
claim_text_en: Together with Tang Yin, Wen Zhengming, and Xu Zhenqing, Zhu was one of the 'Four Talents of Wu' — a later literary grouping. His calligraphy is the most noted in the quartet.
review_note: 此为后世文学并称，非四人生前固定组织。用 reception_label 而非 identity/relationship。

claim_text_zh: 祝允明卒于明嘉靖丙戌十二月二十七日（1527年1月28日）。
claim_text_en: He died on 28 January 1527 (27th day of the 12th month of the bingxu year, Jiajing reign).

date.original_date_text: 嘉靖丙戌冬十有二月二十七日
